shellCommands.command: pwd && ls -la && git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5 && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100

for f in package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html .gitignore src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; echo; done; echo "=== node_modules top"; ls node_modules | head -80; ls node_modules/.bin 2>/dev/null | head -40

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -40 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -100 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index* 2>/dev/null; grep -o "export {[^}]*}" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.js 2>/dev/null | head -c 4000

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && cat index.d.ts | head -60; echo ---; cat components/index.d.ts | head -80; echo ---; ls components/controls components/layout; echo; cat components/controls/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; cat components/layout/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Select/Select.d.ts | head -150; echo ----SWITCH; cat Switch/Switch.d.ts; echo ----CHECKBOX; cat Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; echo ----TEXTINPUT; sed -n 1,80p controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts

cat Select/types.d.ts | head -120; echo ----TECH; cat Select/tech-components.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo ----AVATAR; cat Avatar/Avatar.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; ls Avatar; echo ----BUTTON; sed -n 1,40p Button/Button.d.ts; echo ----FLEX; cat layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -30; echo ---TEXT; cat Text/Text.d.ts | head -30; echo ---CARD; sed -n 1,30p Card/Card.d.ts

cat Avatar/types/main.d.ts | head -60; echo ---; cat Text/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | grep -n "variant" | head; cat Text/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls Text; ls Text/* | head -30; echo; grep -rn "header-1\|body-1" Text/text/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo; cat types.d.ts | grep -n "Space\|ControlGroupOption" | head; cat ../../../../../../node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5

grep -n "ControlProps" -A 14 types.d.ts | head -60; echo ---; grep -n "BaseInputControlProps" -A 30 controls/types.d.ts | head -60; echo ---; grep -n "gap\|Space" layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts layout/Box/Box.d.ts | head; echo ---; grep -n "UseOpenProps" -A3 ../hooks/useSelect/types.d.ts | head -5; ls ../../../../../../node_modules/.bin/ | grep -i "^tsc\|^vite$"; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/typescript/package.json && node -e "console.log(require('/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/typescript/package.json').version)"

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -n "export type Space\b\|export type Space =" -A2 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "export type AvatarSize" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/types/ ; grep -n "toaster" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -3; (npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15)

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Avatar/AvatarImage/*.d.ts | head -20; cat Avatar/AvatarText/*.d.ts | head -12; grep -n "color" Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "TEXT_COLOR\|COLOR" -A3 Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "es2022" -r /dev/null; grep -c "supportedValuesOf" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/typescript/lib/lib.es2022.intl.d.ts
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -40

(which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; node -e "require('playwright')" 2>&1 | head -1; ls node_modules | grep -i "jsdom\|happy-dom\|playwright\|puppeteer"); node --version

cp package.json /tmp/pkg.bak && cp package-lock.json /tmp/lock.bak && timeout 240 npm install --no-save jsdom@25 @testing-library/react@16 @testing-library/user-event@14 @testing-library/dom@10 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -5; git status --short; diff -q package.json /tmp/pkg.bak && diff -q package-lock.json /tmp/lock.bak && echo "manifests unchanged"
timeout 300 npx vitest run --environment jsdom src/__tmp__ 2>&1 | tail -80

timeout 300 npx vitest run -c vitest.tmp.config.mjs 2>&1 | grep -ci "warning\|act(" ; rm -rf src/__tmp__ vitest.tmp.config.mjs dist && cp /tmp/pkg.bak package.json && cp /tmp/lock.bak package-lock.json && npm install --no-save --dry-run >/dev/null 2>&1; git status --short; diff -q package.json /tmp/pkg.bak && diff -q package-lock.json /tmp/lock.bak && echo "manifests restored"; ls node_modules | grep -c "^jsdom$"

timeout 200 npm uninstall --no-save jsdom @testing-library/react @testing-library/user-event @testing-library/dom >/dev/null 2>&1; ls node_modules | grep -c "^jsdom$"; diff -q package.json /tmp/pkg.bak && diff -q package-lock.json /tmp/lock.bak && echo "manifests unchanged"; npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -4; rm -rf dist; git status --short
